data.name: Python Data Analysis Skill
data.description: Master data analysis with pandas, numpy, and matplotlib. This comprehensive skill covers data cleaning, transformation, visualization, and statistical analysis using Python's most popular data science libraries.
data.longDescription: Dive deep into data analysis with hands-on exercises, real-world datasets, and best practices used by top data scientists. Learn to manipulate DataFrames, create stunning visualizations, and extract actionable insights from raw data.

author.bio: Senior data scientist with 10+ years experience in analytics and machine learning.
